## Research proposal

Use **Add paper** on the website to prepare a structured proposal. Paste its JSON into exactly one fenced `json` block in this issue body if you used the download option.

Include the IRP number(s), doctoral candidate name(s), all authors, title, year, subjects, and public links. Publications need their type and venue; working papers need a summary and stage. If open to collaborate, explain the requested contribution and provide a public profile or discussion URL.

Maintainers: review the JSON, then add `publication-approved` to update the CSV and publish automatically. Do not include private contact details, credentials or manuscripts that cannot be shared publicly.
